patch.summary: Is Ocean.io worth it? Sales intelligence platform centered on lookalike and similar-company prospecting — finding companies like your best customers — monetized via a credit model with a published per-credit rate and yearly minimum packaging.. Strong when GTM teams whose primary job is finding lookalike / similar companies to best customers. Weak when Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer.

sections.heading: Ocean.io: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs contact data and GTM teams whose primary job is finding lookalike / similar companies to best customers holds. Counter-signal: Walk when Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: HubSpot, Salesforce.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Credits (yearly minimum), Custom.

sections.heading: Who Ocean.io is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Ocean.io when lookalike / similar-company prospecting is the named buying job and you can model credit minimums..

Avoid if: Compare Clay for multi-provider waterfall enrichment, Apollo for data+sequences, ZoomInfo for enterprise databases, and Bombora when third-party intent (not lookalikes) is the specialist need..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Clay on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Ocean.io price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
